profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Collins Aerospace
profile.summary:
Highly motivated professional. Goal oriented and experienced working with agile teams in dynamic environments demanding strong teamwork, technical, organizational and interpersonal skills.

An outgoing and charismatic individual who will help and lead those around me with positive energy in order to keep moving forward and reach our goals. 

My main objective is to live a full life and make the most of it. I strive to make a positive impact in my circle of influence while building strong everlasting relationships in the process. And these relationships help me expand both: my circle of influence as well as my circle of concern. Some of the character values by which I live my life are: integrity, humility, patience, dedication, courage and justice.
I pursue happiness by surrounding myself with people I respect, care about and love. I believe I was placed on earth to serve a purpose and I will do my best to make a decent size footprint before I'm gone.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: The company was acquired by UTC and now our division is called Collins Aerospace.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Similar work, more responsibilities. Update in progress...

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design, Develop, Verify!
- Develop software for 747-800 and software update to the older model 747-400.
- Write low level requirements matching high level requirements in order to specify details for the software we develop.
- Develop some of the software code for the Cockpit system known as Pro Line Fusion Integrated Flight Deck.
- Create/update Test Cases and Test Procedures in order to verify the graphic components of the Pro Line Fusion for different applicable programs.

positions.title: Network Solutions & IT Technician
positions.description:
Supervised, maintained and supported technical aspects of the network infrastructure in the company using Windows Server 2003 and Microsoft Exchange Server.
Also served as dedicated IT Technician for all computer systems in the office and laptops used in the field.

positions.title: Graphic Designer & Computer/Network Solutions Technician
positions.description:
- Web UI design and development
- Advertisement Graphic Design
- Printing of promotional materials such as Business Cards, Brochures, Postcards, Flyers, Restaurant Menus, etcetera.
- Diagnose and repair computer related issues. Restructuring networking solutions in business environment.

projects.title: Rockwell Collin's Pro Line Fusion®
projects.description: Fully integrated flight deck product line with unsurpassed and pioneering features that make flying safer and more enjoyable for business and commercial aircraft.

projects.title: IDS-7000 Integrated Display System for Boeing 747-400
projects.description: Collaborated with a small team developing changes to the currently delivered software as requested by new Requirements from Boeing.
